demo.end.body:
Thanks for playing Fart Together demo all the way to the end!

We hope you had a blast with your friends.
This is still a demo, so please forgive us if you ran into a few little bugs along the way!
If you enjoyed the game, wishlisting Fart Together on Steam would mean a lot to us.

When you quit, a quick 2-3 minute survey will open. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us!
demo.end.title: YOU COMPLETED THE DEMO!
